_readme: The trunk (curriculum in taxonomy order, with heroes) and its typed branches. Derived branches are refreshed by tools/build_trunk_branches.py; hand branches (provenance hand) and hand drops are kept verbatim. contradicts / queers are NEVER derived — they are readings, authored on /trunk.

trunk.qfep_role: Foundation - points, lines, planes, and basic vectors
Invariants - dot/cross products enable rotation
Foundation - the group as the complete catalog of possible orders; the one census that closes
Foundation - the grid, indexing, addressable repetition
Foundation - color systems become composition systems
Foundation - the calculus substrate. Derivative as instantaneous rate, integral as accumulation, vector field as flow. The vocabulary forces / wavefunctions / randomness / noise will all use.
Newton's laws - vectors become physics
Foundation - the F term made physical; free-energy minimization as the shape matter settles into, stopping short of the dead-perfect bottom
F ↔ E oscillation - sine creates curves
Disorder as creative force
Structured randomness - Perlin, flow fields
Simple rules → complex behavior. Rule 110 is Turing complete — the λ_edge thesis.
Self-similarity, infinite detail
Generative grammars
WFC, Markov, emergence from rules
Deformable matter, cloth, fluid + Turing morphogenesis. Cloth descends an energy landscape under gravity + spring constraints.
Implicit fields → explicit surfaces. Marching cubes as the bridge from continuous fields to walkable mesh.
CSG operations as composition logic — union, intersection, difference of solids.
Collective behavior, stigmergy — local rules + memory of rules → emergent global pattern. Swarm's qfep_term is self-declared λ.
Learning systems, neural networks
Connections define structure. The substrate that was always under it all — every cell, force, agent, neuron was a node; every adjacency, attraction, message, weight was an edge.
Gödel, Russell - limits of formal systems
The complete QFEP formula embodied
Applied limits — bias, rhizomes, molecular design as post-crisis practice
